cond_0001.intro: [Company name masked] is looking for a QA Engineer II to join the QA team, playing a crucial role in developing test suites for [Product name masked] mobile apps and web technologies. This position is integral to a growing team focused on implementing new testing technologies that streamline processes and communication among product, support, and development teams. The role requires a clear understanding of our products, adherence to acceptance criteria, collaboration across various facets, and commitment to upholding product integrity.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Develop and maintain comprehensive, structured test plans and test cases.
Conduct thorough regression, functional, and performance tests to detect and report software defects and ensure product stability.
Investigate and resolve reported issues, meticulously documenting and tracking defects to resolution.
Design, develop, and maintain scalable and robust automation frameworks following industry standards, using tools like Selenium, Appium, Playwright etc.
Collaborate with development and product teams to identify test scenarios and ensure comprehensive test coverage.
Participate actively in Agile/Scrum methodologies, contributing to sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
Continuously convert manual test cases into functional automated scripts.
Generate reliable web-element identifiers and craft custom x-paths for Selenium API.
Perform manual API testing using tools such as Postman and Swagger.
Design API automation scripts using Rest Sharp and execute SQL queries.
Configure and maintain CI/CD pipelines and initiate pipeline tests.
Lead end-to-end testing, defining, and executing test cases, and managing test data creation.
Deliver accurate test progress reports to the QA Leadership team.
Continuously enhance testing processes and methodologies to boost efficiency and effectiveness.
Proactively respond to team messages, comments, and emails to ensure uninterrupted development progress.
Foster a positive and enthusiastic attitude to inspire and energize the team.
Embrace learning new skill sets related to our technological needs.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
3+ Years of experience as a QA Engineer with automation focus
Proficiency in C#, JavaScript, Typescript
Strong working experience with tools like Selenium, Appium, Postman, Swagger, Rest Sharp, SQL, etc.
Strong analytical, interpersonal, and communication skills, coupled with a quick learning ability, diligence, and strong team collaboration
Bachelor's degree in computer science or relevant work experience
Must be able to verify identity and employment eligibility to work in [Location masked]

Familiarity with Playwright

Lead end-to-end testing, defining and executing test cases, and managing test data creation.
Deliver accurate test progress reports to the QA Leadership team, walking them through findings and clarifying any questions.

Embrace learning new skill sets related to our technological needs.

Lead end-to-end testing, defining, and executing test cases, and managing test data creation.

Continuously enhance testing processes and methodologies to boost efficiency and effectiveness.
Proactively respond to team messages, comments, and emails to ensure uninterrupted development progress.

Embrace learning new skill sets related to our technological needs.
